protocolSource: Repository CI protocol fixed before running the synthetic end-to-end injury-AI integration workflow.

outcome.name: Synthetic injury within 28-day future window
outcome.caseDefinition: A deterministic simulation-generated binary event sampled only after the prediction index from a fixed synthetic data-generating process.
outcome.adjudication: Synthetic event status is generated by the version-controlled fixture generator and is never interpreted as a real clinical outcome.

population.description: Synthetic multimodal athlete cohort for engineering integration tests only
population.inclusionCriteria: Version-controlled synthetic participants generated by ml/generate_synthetic_injury_fixture.py.
population.exclusionCriteria: No real people, patients, or athlete records are included.

predictionIndex.definition: Start of each non-overlapping synthetic 28-day prediction window
predictionIndex.predictorCutoffRule: All generated predictors are timestamped at or before the synthetic prediction index.

cameraEvidenceScope.measurementDefinition: Synthetic values shaped like versioned MovementScienceLab 2D MediaPipe projection measurements; not real camera observations and not 3D kinematics.
